title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) - update
summary: WHO has been informed of an additional four laboratory-confirmed cases of infection with Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV).  These include the first laboratory-confirmed case from Oman and three additional laboratory-confirmed cases from Saudi Arabia.

title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) - update
summary: WHO has been informed of an additional laboratory-confirmed case of Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) infection in Qatar.

title: Cholera in Mexico – update
summary: The Ministry of Health in Mexico has reported an additional five cases of infection with Vibrio cholerae O1 Ogawa toxigenic.

title: Human infection with avian influenza A(H7N9) virus – update
summary: The National Health and Family Planning Commission, China notified WHO of a new laboratory-confirmed case of human infection with avian influenza A(H7N9) virus.

title: Report of suspected polio cases in the Syrian Arab Republic
summary: On 17 October 2013, WHO received reports of a cluster of acute flaccid paralysis (AFP) cases in the Syrian Arab Republic. title: Cholera in Mexico
summary: The Ministry of Health in Mexico has reported 171 confirmed cases, including one death,  of infection with Vibrio cholerae O1 Ogawa toxigenic between 9 September to 18 October 2013.

title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) - update
summary: WHO has been informed of an additional laboratory-confirmed cases of Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) infection in Qatar.

title: Human infection with avian influenza A(H7N9) virus – update
summary: The National Health and Family Planning Commission, China notified WHO of a new laboratory-confirmed case of human infection with avian influenza A(H7N9) virus. This is the first new confirmed case of human infection with avian influenza A(H7N9) virus since 11 August 2013.

title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) - update
summary: WHO has been informed of an additional two laboratory-confirmed cases of Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) infection in Saudi Arabia.

title: Yellow fever in Cameroon
summary: The Ministry of Health of Cameroon carried out a yellow fever mass vaccination campaign with a reported 94% coverage of the targeted population of 663 900 in 13 health districts considered to be at high risk of yellow fever.

title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) - update
summary: WHO has been informed of an additional six laboratory-confirmed cases of Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) infection in Saudi Arabia.

title: Wild poliovirus in the Horn of Africa – update
summary: Three suspected cases of wild poliovirus type 1 (WPV1) from South Sudan are currently being investigated.  All three patients are girls, two of whom are approximately  two-years-old and one is eight-years-old.   All had previously been  immunized with oral polio vaccine (OPV).
